record.name: SE Ranking
record.one_liner: An all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform providing tools for keyword research, rank tracking, backlink analysis, and site audits via its robust API.
record.access_note: Users can test the API via a free trial account, sign up for pay-as-you-go, or purchase standalone API/subscription plans.
record.api_note: Covers backlinks, domain research, keyword research, site audits, AI search metrics, and account subscription data.

evidence.quote: Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value Token YOUR_API_KEY.
You can even test it in the free trial account.
All requests to the Data API must be authenticated. The base URL for all endpoints is: https://api.seranking.com
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking
